objective: Provide conditional, capability-stratified measurements of whether a WAM's native action and predicted future are compatible, without assuming that every WAM is future-driven or conflating visual quality with action consistency.

unit_of_analysis.statistical_unit: twin or source_key, never individual intervals when branches share a source

step2_counterfactual_consistency.pair_gate: both branches must provide the required channel; otherwise pair is unavailable

step2_single_branch_alignment.warning: Frozen MAS scope is directional yaw alignment; metric distance/progress/lateral/curvature adapters remain diagnostic and do not replace metric CFAC

future_to_action.required_intervention: hold history and command fixed while perturbing future or future latent
future_to_action.claim_boundary: Delta S_F versus Delta P_A alone establishes consistency, not mediation; if the required future-only intervention is unavailable, this channel is unavailable rather than a zero score

fcs.requirement: native action evaluated by an independent simulator with explicit task labels and task-label provenance

report_contract.composite_policy: report metric vector before considering any aggregate score

current_claim: The framework is a conditional evaluation standard: it does not assume that every WAM is future-driven. Directional-yaw MAS and RCS variants are validated on Epona and DriveWAM with source-level bootstrap gates passed, while metric magnitude/progress channels remain diagnostic. GS is formally frozen for external-future grounding. Future-to-action mediation is an optional evidence channel and remains unavailable until its intervention is supplied; its absence does not invalidate the other scores.
